subject: amap required for hclust,  not availabe for R version 3.5.1

messages.author: bfd8986eda9fa1a2
messages.subject: amap required for hclust,  not availabe for R version 3.5.1
parts:
Hi,
Apologies if this has been reported before but I am new to this.
I Just set up Rattle for the first time and cannot get the hclust functionality to run.
It complains that hclust requires amap, but amap cannot be found. 

When i try and install package amap manually:
>>install.packages("amap")
>>Warning in install.packages :
>>package ‘amap’ is not available (for R version 3.5.1)

... so what do I need to do to get this to install?


Thanks
/Louis

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: amap required for hclust, not availabe for R version 3.5.1
parts:
Hi Louis,

I wonder if it might be because of the version of R you are using. I just tried this on R 3.6.1 and it installed amap okay. Can you update your installation?

Regards,
Graham
